scenes.say: Aaj do minute ka test. Apna business khud Google karo.
Test ek. Near me search karo. Aap pehle teen mein ho?

scenes.title: 3 test, 3 sawaal:
scenes.say: Teen test. Near me mein top teen mein ho? Naam search karne pe timing aur phone sahi hai? Aur last review kitna purana hai?

scenes.text: Customer ne bhi *yahi dekha*, aur *competitor* ko call kiya.
scenes.say: Ek bhi jawab nahi hai, to customer ne bhi yahi dekha, aur competitor ko call kiya.

scenes.sub: Comment TEST: hum free check karke batayenge
scenes.say: Comment karo TEST, hum free check karenge. Ya seedha WhatsApp karo, hum aapke liye set kar denge.

caption:
Aaj 2 minute nikaalo aur apna business khud Google karo. Customer bhi yahi karta hai. 🔍

3 test:
1️⃣ "[aapki service] near me": top 3 mein ho?
2️⃣ Apna naam: timing, photos, phone sahi?
3️⃣ "[naam] reviews": last review kab ka?

Ek bhi "nahi" = customer competitor ke paas gaya.

Comment "TEST" 👇 hum free check karke batayenge.

📲 Ye problem aapke business mein bhi hai? WhatsApp karo: 98131 36114, hum set kar denge.

🏢 Parachar: local businesses ke liye websites, WhatsApp automation aur lead follow-up systems. Leads aayein, chhootein nahi.
